text:
Micah: :rotating_light: Observed sustained GPU queueing and degraded EV across eu-central since ~09:12 UTC — approx 40-50% of GPU capacity showing high CUDNN stalls + rack-level packet drops. Token latency up 3x and queue depth exploding. Proposing emergency per-customer throttles and a short global burst reduction.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20250304-87 created for eu-central GPU degradation. Severity: high. Pager sent to infra oncall.
Sara: Agree with micah. Short plan: 1) temp global burst -20% 2) per-customer caps for top noisy tenants 3) route non-critical traffic to us-west-2 and CPU fallback for low-priority jobs.
Jordan: I can apply the per-customer caps. Running quota command now for the first noisy tenant.
Jordan: ```
redwoodctl quota set --customer acct-9821 --rps 12 --tokens-per-minute 600 --reason "emergency-eu-throttle"
``` 
Jordan: Will confirm when applied.
Tess: Also recommend flipping routing policy to send retryable/async jobs to us-west-2: policy `degraded-eu-traffic` (priority: low -> us-west-2). I'll trigger it and update the routing table.
Micah: Make sure throttled responses include a helpful 429 body with status link and `X-RW-Retry-After` header. Add a short note about reduced throughput so SDKs can back off gracefully.
Deploy-bot: Quota update acknowledged: acct-9821 rps=12 applied at 1753456840 by jordan. Rule id: q-emer-eu-1.
Sara: We should do aggressive KV cache for chat/assistant routes to reduce repeated context tokens. Patch queue config for dedicated-eu if possible.
Jordan: Patching queue config now:
```http
PATCH /config/queues/dedicated-eu HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{"kv_cache":"aggressive","prefetch":true}
```
Jordan: Patch applied at 1753456882.
Oncall-bot: Rate limit rule `emergency-eu-customer-cap` is active across edge and dedicated pools. Triage doc: https://internal/incidents/INC-20250304-87
Tess: Opening a status page update & customer notify draft. Flagging top impacted accounts: @big-retailer @photo-app @newsco — will include estimated window and mitigation.
Customer-success: Please loop me in on the customer note. We should offer proactive outreach and credits if SLAs break.
Micah: Early metrics look promising: queue depth down ~30% since quotas applied, median token latency trending down. Keep throttles in place for 2 hours, then re-evaluate with observed capacity and packet-drop fixes.
Sara: Also turn on short-lived rollback window: if any major customer reports >5% error spike, we revert their cap and open a manual triage.
Jordan: I'll keep a list of applied caps and commands used in the incident log. Current applied: acct-9821, acct-7744, acct-1109. Next batch in 3m if needed.
Deploy-bot: Routing policy `degraded-eu-traffic` activated at 1753456905.
Micah: Action items recap: jordan apply remaining caps, tess publish customer status, sara coordinate credits/CS outreach, micah monitor infra metrics and packet-drop graph. Meet back at +30m.
Tess: Draft posted to status; linking internal note and customers for review.
Customer-success: Thanks — I'll prep the outreach templates and hold for final signoff.
Micah: :white_check_mark: Keeping this thread as single-source for changes. Will close when all caps removed and latency normalized. Next update in 30m unless changed.
